coverage.authoredAnalysis: Cover identifies BNG decalogue and Galicia agenda, without an explicit date in this image. Primary programme publication chain still needs final election check.

Congress/Senate representation introduction, then commitments 1-4: transfer AP-9 and remove tolls; 200 million euros for Galicia dependency care; A-6 viaduct reconstruction, AP-53 transfer/toll discount, specified rail improvements and metropolitan commuter rail; Galicia electricity tariff and just-transition auctions for Meirama/As Pontes (1,400 MW evacuation node). Energy commitment continues onto page 3.

Completes commitment 4: renewable planning with public-service, environmental and participation safeguards; reject offshore wind on Galicia coast. Commitments 5-8: specialised gender-violence courts in five named places; minimum wage/minimum pension to 60% of average wage, retirement 65 and partial 61, ten-year pension reference, minimum-income administration transfer; public-security-law repeal and recognition of State nations; remove Article 2 e/f of Amnesty Law concerning Franco-era impunity and restore confiscated property; 35 named-domain transfers through bilateral dialogue. Do not confuse this historical Amnesty Law proposal with the later independence amnesty.

Commitments 9-10: increase annual investment in Galicia to 2 billion euros; State absorbs A Coruña outer-port infrastructure cost/debt and inner-port land becomes city property. Party comparisons with other ports are campaign claims, not verified quiz consequences. End of document; no annex/footnote.
